description: a ball of radius 2 revolved about z less a drill of radius 0.5 whose axis stands 0.5 from the ball's: the wall runs through both poles, so each of the two traced section loops (ADR-0018) passes through a singular point of the sphere. The operand's pole vertex paves each loop (ADR-0021) into one block from the pole back to it, its pcurve fitted over a range ending on the point twice, and the pole's degenerate edge is paved at the two `u` the loop arrives with. Open CASCADE builds this pose; the pose of plans/c3-conic-hits step 5's note, a wall through one pole only, it does not. The tolerances are stated at 3e-9 and 5e-9 because the oracle's own measurement is the far side: in polar coordinates about the ball's axis the bore is r ≤ cos φ, so the volume is 32π/3 − ∫ 2/3 (8 − (4 − cos² φ)^{3/2}) dφ and the area 16π − ∫ 4 (2 − √(4 − cos² φ)) dφ + ∫ 2 √(4 − cos² φ) dφ over [−π/2, π/2], single integrals of smooth integrands that Gauss–Legendre gives as 30.5215784780915 and 60.3518342528646; Arris measures 30.5215784777700 and 60.3518342514656 at the default tolerance, 1.1e-11 and 2.3e-11 away, and moves toward them as the model tolerance goes to 1e-9, while Open CASCADE's 30.5215785490 and 60.3518343651 are 2.3e-9 and 1.9e-9 away, its centroid 6.8e-10 off the plane z = 0 the solid is symmetric in where Arris's is 1.8e-16
